_comment: Shared TypeScript config for every federated member under apps/.
Before this file the 17 apps carried three byte-distinct tsconfig.json
variants in an 8/7/2 split — drift, not intent. The two differences were
an extra 'src/**/*.d.ts' include (kept, it picks up css.d.ts) and a
missing useDefineForClassFields (kept as true, which is already the
default at target ES2022, so nothing changes for the two apps that
NOT to be confused with the root tsconfig.json, which is vestigial:
it sets jsx: react-jsx in a repo where React is prohibited, targets
ES2020 while every app targets ES2022, and nothing extends it.
Only compilerOptions live here. include/exclude deliberately stay in
each app: TypeScript resolves those paths relative to the file they are
WRITTEN in, not the one doing the extending, so a shared 'src/**/*.ts'
would resolve to '<root>/src/**/*.ts' and every app would compile zero
